conventions.convention: For a right principal bundle, s_j=s_i g_ij gives A_j=Ad_(g_ij^-1) A_i+g_ij^-1 dg_ij. The BPST transition is s_S=s_N u^-1.
The Hodge star satisfies α∧*β=〈α,β〉vol. On two-forms in oriented Riemannian dimension four, *²=1 and F±=(F±*F)/2.
Charge is q_B=(8π²)^-1∫B(F∧F). For defining SU(2), B=-tr₂ and q_B=-〈c₂(E),[X]〉. General invariant B gives a real characteristic number without an integrality assertion.
The action is S_B=g^-2∫B(F∧*F), with g>0. Positive-charge equality is self-dual, negative-charge equality is ASD, and zero-charge equality requires flat curvature.

The north stereographic chart is positively oriented, p₀=(0,0,0,0,1), p∞=(0,0,0,0,-1), y=x/|x|², T_a=-iσ_a/2, and ρ>0. This orientation agrees with the boundary orientation of the Euclidean five-ball.
Full AC is assumed for the charge interface and its consumers, including the compact elliptic/Hodge and characteristic-class inputs to the spin calculation.
Clifford multiplication has negative square, Γ=-c(e₁)c(e₂)c(e₃)c(e₄), and S+ is its +1 eigensubbundle. The explicit twist is E=S+ with its lifted Levi-Civita SU(2) connection.
Fredholm assertions concern bounded H¹→L² chiral operators; full Dirac selfadjointness concerns unbounded L² operators with domain H¹. The inverse determinant fiber is (det ker D+)⁎⊗det coker D+.

Total spinor periodicity is the product of spin and gauge clutch multipliers. Central gauge clutch -1 combined with antiperiodic spin clutch gives periodic total spinors; periodic spin clutch instead gives antiperiodic total spinors.

load_bearing.statement: Under full AC, on the specified nonempty connected compact oriented closed Riemannian four-manifold, q_B=(8π²)^-1∫B(F∧F) is independent of the supplied principal connection. For defining SU(2) and B=-tr₂, q_B=-〈c₂(E),[X]〉∈Z; no integrality is asserted for general G and B.

Under full AC, the specified two-chart SU(2) potentials on the oriented unit round S⁴, for every ρ>0, define a smooth principal connection with the displayed curvature. It is self-dual, has q_B=1, and has S_B(g)=8π²/g² for every g>0.

Under full AC, the specified round-S⁴ twist E=S+ has the scale-one self-dual BPST connection, Chern number -1, and bounded chiral Dirac realization with complex kernel dimension 1, cokernel dimension 0 and index 1. Parallel unitary identifications intertwine this operator with (f,ω)↦df+√2d*ω.

Under full AC, for the stipulated compact spin four-manifold, reduction-compatible SU(2) connection and Fredholm chiral realization, the periodic product real kernel has dimension n₊+n₋ and parity equal to the chiral index modulo two. The central inverse-determinant action is (-1)^(n₊+n₋). For the explicit round twist the real kernel dimension is 1 and the action is -1; antiperiodic total spinors give no product zero mode.

For the specified compact closed four-dimensional gauge data under full AC, S_B≥8π²|q_B|/g². Equality is self-dual when q_B>0, ASD when q_B<0, and flat when q_B=0. Every supplied self-dual or ASD connection satisfies D_A(*F)=0.

For an oriented four-dimensional real inner-product space V and finite-dimensional real inner-product space W, the Hodge star on Λ²V*⊗W is an isometric involution with orthogonal ±1 eigenspaces and unique projections (I±*)/2. Rescaling g to λ²g, λ>0, leaves this star unchanged.

For a Hausdorff second-countable smooth manifold X=U∪V, a finite-dimensional Hausdorff second-countable real Lie group G, and smooth τ:U∩V→G, the stated quotient gluing (x,h)_V∼(x,τ(x)h)_U forms a smooth right principal G-bundle with s_V=s_Uτ.

alerts.finding: The Definition calls I_ASD(k,N) a 'moduli set' consisting of 'framed pairs (E,A) ... modulo the stated based gauge transformations', while those transformations were defined as automorphisms of E. E ranges over unrestricted bundle total-space sets; relabeling even the trivial flat bundle on arbitrarily high-rank carrier sets produces objects that these automorphisms cannot identify. No set of bundle representatives or set-valued coding of framed objects is specified. The minimum-rank sector convention in the gauge-data supplier does not explicitly construct this quotient of varying framed bundles.

The Definition says the framed ASD sector is 'the set of such framed connections ... modulo smooth unitary gauge transformations whose value at infinity is the identity'. The principal bundle P is unrestricted, and no fixed representative family or minimum-rank coding of framed connections is supplied. Already the k=0 trivial flat objects admit arbitrarily high-rank relabelings of their total spaces. The claimed set therefore needs an explicit set-sized construction; even unrestricted isomorphism classes require coding rather than literal equivalence classes.

Fact F2 and Proof 1.2 apply the instanton definition and self-dual action bound to infer that zero-charge ASD curvature vanishes, but the Example and Given clauses contain no full-AC assumption. Both cited owned suppliers explicitly assume full AC, and the example has neither an axiom declaration nor a local replacement argument explaining its weaker requirements. State the inherited assumption or justify the conclusion without that conditional citation.

The sector definition preserves q=-c₂, explicitly identifies the full-AC qualification of its integral comparison, and uses κ=2B_top so its physical action matches the mathematical normalization.

The BPST example specifies the actual charts, transition, orientation and trace normalization; full AC is explicit. Its saddle claim has a separate first-variation calculation, and the exponential weight remains explicitly formal.

The page declares this prerequisite, but its current item bodies contain no direct invocation of the assigned instanton propositions. No strengthened quotation or conflicting instanton normalization was found.

The anomaly test preserves full AC, reduction-compatible SU(2) connection, bounded chiral Fredholm realization, periodic total spinors and inverse-determinant convention. The general index-one hypothesis is distinguished from the proved concrete round instance.

The concrete example uses exactly the round E=S+ twist, kernel dimension one, cokernel zero and periodic-product parity one. Its bulk response remains an adopted input and its conclusion is limited to the stated loop.

The definition restricts N≥2, assumes full AC, uses k=-q_N for ASD connections and explicitly declines to infer U(N) integrality from the special SU(2) clause. Its separate moduli-set construction issue is routed as an alert.

N≥2, ASD sign and trace normalization agree. The determinant-flatness lemma proves the U(N) Chern-number conversion separately instead of overstating the SU(2) integrality supplier. The moduli-set issue is separate.

The zero-charge ASD application has the correct rank, trace and sign, but the example omits the full-AC hypothesis of the charge and action-bound suppliers. This omission is routed to the example owner.
